newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig started as a buy.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said it initiated coverage of Minas Gerais state power utility Cemig with a long-term buy recommendation.
-- "Competitive energy production costs, low gearing and strategic positioning in the industry all support our recommendation that investors buy the shares for the long-term," it said in a report.
-- It also said Cemig is a natural candidate for a leading position in the rapidly growing, deregulated electricity market that is evolving in Brazil.
-- It added that an expected sale of a 33 percent stake will increase the company's efficiency.
-- Cemig preferred shares were flat at 31.10 reais at 1500 local time/1400 EDT/1800 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
